thread:
leo: Heads-up: sample-app flaky after today's typegen regen. Embeddings signature changed; positional string -> array.

molly: oh no. quick paste of failing expect?

leo: Received: { input: [ 'hi' ] }
Expected: { input: 'hi' }

nick: This is the third time oneOf/anyOf flattening has bitten us. Regen-diff missed it because the file hash changed but call-site ergonomics did.

regen-bot: regen job finished for package/sdk-ts at 2127001200 1 file updated (typegen).

molly: short-term: shim in the client to accept string and map to options. Long-term: enhance regen-diff CI to run a lightweight smoke script that imports built client and executes common call patterns.

docsmith: add changelog note: "fix(sdk): preserve positional embedding param via compatibility shim". Also update onboarding docs noting this ergonomic caveat.

leo: i'll open the PR with shim + unit test. PR will also add regen-smoke runner to the typegen workflow.

ci-bot: draft PR leo/patch-embeddings-safety #621 queued for CI.

molly: good. after patch publish we should rerun sample-app pipeline on the pinned CI image. Follow-up: file an issue to detect signature-only changes during regen (AST-based comparator).

nick: agree. also consider emitting explicit overloads from generator when schema allows a single-string convenience param. saves headaches.

leo: PR link in thread when ready. ping #devex for any other regressions. :thumbsup:
